title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Enjoyed the chat yesterday. Thanks for taking the time. Re: Rosenthal, do you guys have any control over him? Or does he just become a FA again after the season
No he was released from that ML contract. We signed him to a separate MN contract and subsequently selected him. so the option on his WSH contract isn’t apart of our deal.
